name: triperly
description: Triperly — family trip planner. Survey-driven, nap-aware itineraries grounded in real venue data and personalized by Claude.
comment: Heavy deps are imported lazily so the core server + rules engine still run with nothing installed. AI SDKs load only when their key is set. Persistence uses the built-in node:sqlite (Node >=22.5) by default and needs no install; set DATABASE_URL to use Postgres (optional 'pg' dependency). better-sqlite3 is auto-detected if you choose to install it.
